shots.description: The ranked board: 178 pre-token protocols ordered by implied value — 40 watchlist plus 138 early below the $50M floor — with the method checks, search box, category filter and sort above the table.

A protocol detail view for the top-ranked protocol, Steakhouse Financial: the model's inputs and arithmetic, the traded token anchoring its multiple, why it ranks first, and its eight-step costed farm plan.
The board filtered to the watchlist only, showing 40 of the 178 rows and the filter controls in use.
